32041-(R1890).s: The bill, a Rijkswet, establishes maritime boundaries between Curaçao and Bonaire, and between Sint Maarten and Saba, by listing coordinate points for great-circle arcs and tying the endpoints to tripoints with Venezuela and France. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree and is to be published in the Staatsblad and the Publicatieblad of the Netherlands Antilles.
32041-(R1890).j: The memorandum gives no justification for the royal-decree entry-into-force delegation; it only explains the background of the referenda and the dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles.
q: This Rijkswet enters into force on a date to be set by royal decree.
Deze rijkswet treedt in werking met ingang van een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: fixing the date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: The PvdA wants to know whether the government, Antillean States, island executives and island councils all agree without reservation to the new boundaries, and how any reservations were answered.

they would like to know whether all the parties involved, namely the government and States of the Netherlands Antilles, the executive boards and councils of all the islands involved, can agree without any reservation or qualification to the new maritime boundaries laid down in this bill

zouden zij, mede in hun hoedanigheid van lid van het Koninkrijksparlement graag vernemen of alle betrokken partijen, te weten de regering en Staten van de Nederlandse Antillen, de Bestuurscolleges en de Raden van alle betrokken eilanden zonder enig voorbehoud of kanttekening kunnen instemmen

The Antillean parliament asks the government for clarity on maritime zones, resource rights and the constitutional status of a 'Koninkrijksparlement', and demands that a constitutional error be corrected.

The Staten consider it necessary that this serious and multi-interpretable constitutional error be corrected, so that later neither the Tweede Kamer nor the PvdA fractie will claim newly formed constitutional bodies, as has happened before in the current constitutional restructuring process.

De Staten achten het noodzakelijk dat deze ernstige en multi-interpretabele constitutionele fout wordt hersteld, zodat naderhand, zoals in het verleden is voorgekomen in het huidige staatkundige structuur-traject, noch de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal, noch de PvdA-fractie nieuwgevormde constitutionele organen gaan claimen.

32251-(R1905).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the International Convention for the Protection of All Persons from Enforced Disappearance adopted in New York on 20 December 2006, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, and the explanatory memorandum describes the Convention's detention, record-keeping and oversight-committee obligations.
32251-(R1905).j: The memorandum justifies approval by noting that detention by the state rests on criminal and penitentiary law with procedural safeguards, and that the Convention creates a supervisory committee alongside existing mechanisms.
q: To that end, the Convention establishes the Committee on Enforced Disappearances.
Het Verdrag roept daartoe het Comité voor gedwongen verdwijningen in het leven.
p: Approval of the Convention commits the state to prohibitions on secret detention, record-keeping and access to information, which strengthen citizens' protection against detention by the state.

parties: Asks about the slow pace of ratification, practical enforcement burdens on the judiciary, and how the Convention would apply to specific cases.
These members, however, have questions about the speed with which this is being pursued.
Deze leden hebben echter vragen over de voortvarendheid die wordt betracht.

Welcomes ratification but asks for reconsideration of the sentencing level, for codifying the offence also in the Criminal Code, and for explanation of Article 24 on victims' rights to truth and redress.
The aforementioned members ask for a reconsideration of the sentencing level.
Voornoemde leden vragen om een heroverweging met betrekking tot de strafmaat.
Welcomes the stronger prosecution basis but asks about retroactivity, the end of the continuing offence, prosecution policy, capacity implications, and jurisdictional competence.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised approval of the UN Convention on Enforced Disappearance across the Kingdom but asked for better efforts to secure its extension to the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba and clearer explanation of the timing of implementing legislation. The government replied by adding to the explanatory memorandum that the Aruban government also considers extension desirable.
concerns: The Raad asked that the explanatory memorandum state when the implementing legislation for the Antilles and Aruba is expected to be ready, or explain the consequences if it is not.
The Raad advised promoting extension of the Convention to all parts of the Kingdom, given the importance of preventing enforced disappearances and protecting victims.

32360-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement for the Central Financiën Instellingen and Nationaal Archief operating-and-cost services, adjusting appropriations and expenditures to realised outcomes. It is a budget closing law (slotwet) that restates the articles and figures of the budget statements without shifting any rule-making or decision power.
32360-VIII.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to higher or lower realised expenditures than budgeted, such as asylum reception costs, vmbo-mbo experiments and delayed free-textbook spending.
q: Because concrete spending proposals for the introduction costs of free school books were lacking, the budget was not fully spent in 2009, resulting in an underspend of €7.2 million.

In verband met het ontbreken van concrete bestedingsvoorstellen voor invoeringskosten gratis schoolboeken is in 2009 het budget niet volledig uitgeput en dit heeft geleid tot een onderuitputting van € 7,2 miljoen.

32565-XII.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, with effect from 1 December 2010, to reflect the Autumn Budget Review (Najaarsnota). The amended budget lines are set out in an attached supplementary budget table.
q: The departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) for 2010 is amended, as shown in the related table attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33240-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, along with the budget statements for its agency-run services, and sets the entry-into-force provisions for the amendment. It presents budget figures by policy article and records realised spending, revenue and budget shifts for 2011.
q: This leads to lower commitments of € 28 million.
Dit leidt tot lagere verplichtingen van € 28 mln.

33605-XV.s: This bill is a final supplementary budget act (slotwet) for 2012 that amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget for its operating-cost services (Agentschap SZW and Inspectie Werk en Inkomen). It sets the budget figures for the year in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV)

34057-(R2043).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2007 Nairobi International Convention on the Removal of Wrecks, which lets coastal states act in their exclusive economic zones to remove wrecks and recover costs from shipowners. It is an approval law with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The International Convention on the Removal of Wrecks concluded at Nairobi on 18 May 2007 ... is approved for the entire Kingdom.
Het op 18 mei 2007 te Nairobi tot stand gekomen Internationaal Verdrag inzake het opruimen van wrakken ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom supports the draft Kingdom act approving the 2007 Nairobi Wreck Removal Convention but objects that the explanatory memorandum invokes customary international law for measures in the exclusive economic zone without justifying the conditions for customary law. The government's reply states that the reference to customary law has been deleted and the implementing bill's scope in the EEZ is limited to the 1969 Brussels Intervention Convention, so the bill no longer rests on customary law.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not show why measures in the EEZ to remove wrecks meet the conditions for customary international law, so it should specify the basis for that claim.

34475-VII.s: This is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) for 2015 that amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget of its agency RvIG, adjusting appropriations and expenditures against the original and supplementary budgets. The bill contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were provided.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34550-XV.s: This bill sets the 2017 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) and the budget statement for its agency SZW, in thousands of euros. It also sets the commencement date of 1 January of the budget year and provides for retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2017 belonging to this act is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34640-(R2081).s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval for the 2014 Protocol to the ILO Forced Labour Convention, so that the Kingdom of the Netherlands can be bound by it. The explanatory memorandum notes that the Protocol's provisions are largely instructions to states rather than directly enforceable rights, and describes how the Netherlands implements them, including in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
34640-(R2081).j: The memorandum justifies approval by stating that the Protocol's articles are mostly instructions to states and not directly binding on individuals, so they cannot ground enforceable individual claims.
q: Mostly the articles in these conventions are not provisions that by their content can bind everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Veelal vormen de artikelen in deze verdragen geen bepalingen die naar hun inhoud eenieder kunnen verbinden als bedoeld in de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill approving the 2014 ILO Protocol on forced labour may proceed, but asked that the explanatory memorandum explain how the government complied with its duty to inform and consult the BES island councils about not yet ratifying the Protocol for the Caribbean Netherlands. The government's reply states it supplemented paragraph 1.5 of the explanatory memorandum and made some textual corrections.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should state that the duty to inform and consult the BES island councils about not ratifying the Protocol for those islands was observed.

34725-XII.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the budget statements of its agencies (RWS, ILT, KNMI, NEa), recording final budget adjustments and realisations. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and does not alter the powers of the executive or oversight bodies.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) for 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34730-XV.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and of its agency, following the spring budget memorandum, mainly by adjusting expenditure and receipt estimates. The explanatory memorandum covers budget reallocations, subsidy transfers and a reduced UWV/unemployment-related estimate without introducing new executive powers.

34950-XII.s: This bill is the Dutch 2017 Slotwet (final budget act) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, setting the final departmental budget and agency budgets (RWS, ILT, KNMI, NEa) for 2017 in thousands of euros. It amends the 2017 appropriations and realizations by article, with the explanatory memorandum noting reallocation of responsibilities between ministers and the effective date tied to the Staatsblad publication.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed and resolved, as We deem and resolve hereby
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

35000-XIV.s: This bill fixes the 2019 budget (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agency NVWA, and the Animal Health Fund, in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities such as strengthened NVWA inspection, animal welfare and food safety, but contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Adopted departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2019
Vastgestelde departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2019

35000-XVI.s: This bill formally establishes the 2019 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, including expenditure and revenue by policy article, and the operating budgets of three executive agencies (CBG, CIBG, RIVM). It also sets the budgetary and capital figures for those agencies and includes the explanatory memorandum describing spending priorities and policy measures.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2019 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35206-(R2127).s: This bill makes a set of technical and largely consequential amendments to several Dutch rijkswetten in the justice and security field, mainly to reflect the reorganisation of courts (such as designating the rechtbank Gelderland and gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden) and renumbered or renamed provisions of the Wetboek van Strafvordering and other laws. It also tightens the rules on when a military suspect may be assisted by an officier-raadsman instead of a lawyer, requiring an explicit request and a voluntary, unambiguous waiver of the right to a lawyer.
35206-(R2127).j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical adjustments to reflect amended legislation and court reorganisation, and explains the officier-raadsman restriction as a safeguard so that suspects are properly advised.
q: The law will however clarify that a suspect may only be assisted by an officier-raadsman instead of a lawyer when he explicitly requests it and voluntarily and unambiguously waives the right to a lawyer under article 28a Sr.

In de wet zal evenwel worden verduidelijkt dat een verdachte alleen kan worden bijgestaan door een officier-raadsman in plaats van een advocaat wanneer hij hier expliciet om verzoekt en wanneer hij overeenkomstig artikel 28a Sr vrijwillig en ondubbelzinnig afstand doet van het recht op een advocaat.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 4 WMS), Artikel I, onderdeel K (art. 23 WMS)

A suspect may be assisted by an officier-raadsman instead of a lawyer only upon explicit request and an unambiguous waiver of the right to counsel, with the officier appointed only if willing, which strengthens procedural safeguards for the accused.

parties: Asks whether legal assistance by a non-lawyer officer-raadsman is compatible with the fair trial guarantee of Article 6 ECHR, and asks who could be designated as military authority.
This officer-raadsman has received tailored training, but he is not a lawyer.
Deze officier-raadsman heeft een daarop toegesneden scholing ontvangen, maar hij is geen advocaat.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill amending several Kingdom Acts, mainly technical, is broadly supported but that the position and task of the officier-raadsman in military criminal procedure should be clarified in the explanatory memorandum. The government reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented on these points and that additional technical amendments and transitional coordination provisions were included.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum clarify the formal position and task of the officier-raadsman, including impartiality toward the joint employer and confidentiality of communications, so that a suspect can make an informed waiver of the right to counsel.
Technical amendments and cross-references affected by the court map reform were added to several Kingdom Acts, and coordination provisions were included.

35450-XV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, with total expenditure changes of minus 0.2 billion euro, mainly driven by revised forecasts for unemployment and sickness benefits. It is a budget appropriation law (begrotingswet) that adjusts spending authorisations and does not delegate rule-making power.
35450-XV.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by new forecasts from the CPB and court rulings requiring compensation, not by any new executive power.
q: This is due to processing a new forecast of labour supply from the CPB.
Dit komt door verwerking van een nieuwe prognose van het arbeidsaanbod van het CPB.

35850-XII.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the budget for its agencies through a first supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force with retroactive effect to 1 June 2021.
q: The changes in the First Supplementary Budget 2021 are smaller than the applied threshold and are therefore not explained.
De wijzigingen in de Eerste suppletoire begroting 2021 zijn kleiner dan de gehanteerde norm en worden daarom niet toegelicht.

36120-XIII.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget (first supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, including the budgets of its agencies, shifting appropriations across policy articles, most notably for Groningen earthquake damage compensation. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2022.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and of the budget statement on agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2022.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2022.

36350-XV.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment through a first supplementary budget, adjusting spending and commitments across social security, benefits and labour market articles. It sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 June 2023.
36350-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to updated labour market forecasts from the CPB and realised spending in 2022, not by any claim to new executive powers.
q: Because the CPB expects a higher unemployed labour force in the coming years, benefit spending is revised upward by € 38.8 million in 2023, rising to € 52.7 million in 2027.
Doordat het CPB een hogere werkloze beroepsbevolking verwacht in de komende jaren, worden de bijstandsuitgaven opwaarts bijgesteld met € 38,8 miljoen in 2023 oplopend tot € 52,7 miljoen in 2027.

36410-VIII.s: This bill sets the 2024 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statements for its agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum extract covers policy priorities, budget interventions and evaluation programmes, but contains no explicit delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this law for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2024 budget bill for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) and raised no comments, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The accompanying letter from the Minister of Finance transmits the advisory opinions and confirms the advice was forwarded.

36435-XII.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the operating budgets of its agencies (Rijkswaterstaat and KNMI) by reallocating spending and receipts, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 19 September 2023. The explanatory memorandum describes budget shifts between policy articles, such as deferring VTH funding to 2026 and transferring funds to the ILT inspectorate.
36435-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by describing the specific reallocations and their causes, such as delayed coordination with partners, but does not justify any delegation or new powers.
q: For licensing, supervision and enforcement (VTH), € 6.0 million is shifted from 2023 to 2026.
Voor de vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving (VTH) wordt € 6,0 miljoen vanuit 2023 naar 2026 geschoven.

36600-XX.s: This bill sets the 2025 departmental budget for the Ministry of Asylum and Migration (article 1) and the 2025 budget of the agency IND (article 2), in thousands of euros, with the memorandum noting the bill-level budget figures and related migration policy context. It does not itself delegate rule-making power or shift powers between executive and checks.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2025 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

36643-(R2202).s: The bill moves the rules on issuing the Dutch identity card (NIK) out of the Paspoortwet into a separate law, and amends the Paspoortwet, Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap and related laws to keep existing registrations and powers working. It also repeals obsolete provisions and sets an entry-into-force date by Royal Decree.
36643-(R2202).j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and retained powers as necessary to preserve the existing administrative practice after moving the NIK into a separate law.
q: To preserve the possibility of withdrawing a travel document at the counter when someone applies for an NIK, moving the NIK into a separate law requires provision in article 50b of the Paspoortwet.

Om de mogelijkheid te behouden om een reisdocument aan de balie in te houden op het moment dat iemand een NIK of een vervangende NIK aanvraagt, is het bij onderbrenging van de NIK in een aparte wet nodig om in artikel 50b van de Paspoortwet te bepalen
d: validity period, territorial validity and model of travel documents
grounds and manner for permanently withdrawing identity cards from circulation
data recorded in the central register on lost or lapsed documents
p: Repeals transitional provision on passports and identity cards, a technical clean-up.
Gives the Gouverneur power to permanently withdraw Dutch identity cards from circulation, with grounds to be set by general administrative order.

parties: The VVD has no questions on this bill and refers to its questions on the related identity card bill.
The present bill gives these members no cause to ask questions.
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen.

The NSC welcomes the aims but raises doubts about feasibility and legal implications and asks how the government will analyse municipal bottlenecks, including whether an impact analysis will be carried out.
Can the government clarify whether, and if so when, an impact analysis will be carried out and how possible bottlenecks will be analysed?
Kan de regering verhelderen of, en zo ja, wanneer er een impactanalyse wordt uitgevoerd en hoe eventuele knelpunten worden geanalyseerd?
The BBB asks what the expected consequences are for citizens in the application and issuance processes for the identity card.
Can the government elaborate on this?
Kan de regering hier nader op in gaan?
The ChristenUnie supports the bill's aims and has no questions.
These members support the aims the bill pursues.
Deze leden steunen de doelen die het wetsvoorstel beoogt.

Questions whether retaining NIK data under the amended law complies with the subsidiarity principle and whether it is a genuine disentanglement, and asks about safeguards for privacy and data security.
Can the Kingdom government explain whether the storage of data under this bill is in line with the principle of subsidiarity?
Kan de Koninkrijksregering uitleggen of het bewaren van data conform dit wetsvoorstel in overeenstemming is met het subsidiariteitsbeginsel?
Argues that passport revocations after years of holding a Dutch passport, leaving citizens stateless, are disproportionate, and asks for a legal remedy to protect affected Curaçao citizens.
The faction questions whether the investigations underlying the revocation of these passports are proportionate.
De fractie vraagt zich af of de onderzoeken die ten grondslag liggen aan het intrekken van deze paspoorten wel proportioneel zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom raised no remarks on the draft rijkswet amending the Paspoortwet in connection with decoupling the Dutch identity card, and advised submitting it to parliament and the Estates of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. The government's nader rapport reports that, on its own initiative, it added changes to the bill (RVVR register provisions, explicit Governor powers, and a co-existence provision) without any Afdeling objection being addressed.

36725-VII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 budget for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the related agency budgets, shifting funds between items and articles. The explanatory memorandum covers reallocations for the IMG Groningen compensation body, legal aid, and strengthening the rule of law such as the Constitutional Court and Council of State.
36725-VII.j: The memorandum justifies the reallocations by reference to the cabinet's response to the parliamentary inquiry and to updated cost estimates, without any delegation of power.
q: In the cabinet response to the parliamentary inquiry it was announced that the IMG will be given the authority to resolve individual bottlenecks in claims handling more swiftly.
In de kabinetsreactie op de parlementaire enquête is aangekondigd dat het IMG de bevoegdheid krĳgt om individuele knelpunten in de schadeafhandeling voortvarender op te lossen

36800-XV.s: The bill is the 2026 budget act (Wet) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, establishing the departmental budget statement in thousands of euros and setting entry into force on 1 January 2026 with retroactive effect if published later. The attached explanatory memorandum extract covers the VBAR bill on employment relationships, planned changes to labour and social security schemes, and the management and oversight of benefit administration bodies.
36800-XV.j: The memorandum does not justify any delegation or new executive power; it describes budgets, policy plans and existing administrative roles.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this act for the year 2026 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport confirms this blank advice and reports technical adjustments to articles on Bijstand/Participatiewet, Kinderopvang and Rijksbijdragen to reflect updated CPB figures, raising expenditure to 65,707,199 thousand euros and revenues to 2,630,327 thousand euros.
